lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are visible in a grid-like arrangement posterior to the gill slits. Centroids of these clusters form identifiable vertical columns with roughly equidistant spacing between points within a column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with horizontal lines of similar intensity. High-luminance circular blobs are localized precisely at these intersection points, creating a distinct node-based grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A linear feature is visible on the upper third of the flank, running horizontally. It is defined by a high-contrast boundary with higher pixel values on the dorsal side and a shadow gradient on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily clustered near the leading edge and mid-section of the fin's surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Red-shifted pixel clusters are present near the third and fourth gill slits. The posterior edge of the pectoral fin shows an irregular, non-smooth margin indicative of a notch or tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: A secondary low-luminance object with a streamlined silhouette is visible in the water column immediately adjacent to the ventral flank, posterior to the pectoral fin.
